text: The eVault is the source of truth and your database a projection (Data-Ownership-Rules.md). handleChange sends local changes through the Web3 Adapter's mapping to the owner's eVault (Web3-Adapter.md); awareness delivers them to the other platforms' /api/webhook at least once: deduplicate on eventId, return 200 even for unknown ontologies (Awareness-Protocol.md). A new entity needs an ontology from the Ontology service, an owner eName and a write path.
